notes: Utah publishes dental rates only through the interactive Coverage and Reimbursement Fee Schedule Download Tool (https://health.utah.gov/stplan/lookup/FeeScheduleDownload.php, provider type 028 Dentist), linked from medicaid.utah.gov/coverage-and-reimbursement. health.utah.gov refuses connections from this network (ECONNREFUSED via curl and WebFetch) and the tool output is form-generated, so no Wayback copy exists. No fee recorded. Per the tool notes (search snippets), fees exclude the rural/urban-agreement dental enhancement (state plan: 20% enhancement).
notes_2024: Not retrievable for the same reason.
